Hi Maya — appreciate the note and great meeting you. Happy to run through options and set expectations for AWS co-sell activation. Quick summary up front:

- We can support both 18- and 36-month private offers. Pricing is steeper at 36 months (we can give a deeper discount but require a minimum annual commit).
- Co-sell activation for AWS Marketplace requires documented buyer approvals (procurement + finance + line-of-business exec) and the marketplace activation evidence pack (SLA expectations, PO or committed spend, and contact for billing).

Vanessa and Ben — can you pull the specific discount tiers and the standard evidence pack we provide to customers to get co-sell enrollment? Laura, can you flag any finance approvals or billing prerequisites we should call out to Quantaflow?

Maya — I"'ll loop back with a compact matrix (term / price / buyer approvals) and a short checklist we can include in the PO submission. If Quantaflow prefers a 36-month cadence we can outline a staged activation (co-sell after year 1 acceptance + consumption thresholds) to give procurement comfort.

Next steps: we"'ll send a one-pager and an example PO draft today. Does Quantaflow have a signatory list for procurement and finance we should include in the Buyer Approval Matrix?

Thanks — quick operational take from marketplace pricing/activation side:

1) If Quantaflow chooses 36 months we can offer a 9% effective discount vs list, but we will require either: a) an annual committed spend floor, or b) a 12-month review with consumption thresholds to keep co-sell active. This is our standard risk control for long-dated private offers.

2) For 18 months we can be more flexible on commit floors, but the discount band narrows to ~3-5% depending on units. For SMB-size pilots we usually push 18 months + consumption-based top-ups.

3) Approval gating: recommend listing explicit approvers in the Buyer Approval Matrix and confirming a point-of-contact for AWS co-sell enablement (this is what AWS asks for). We also need billing & contact info for the Marketplace account owner.

Operational ask: Vivek / Maya — please confirm the names/emails for procurement + finance + LOB exec so Vanessa can populate the Buyer_Approval_Matrix and I can draft the private-offer pricing that legal will attach. I"'ve attached a quick draft PO template (Quantaflow_Private_Offer_Draft.docx) so procurement can see the fields we need in their PO. Once we have that, we can submit the private offer to AWS within 48 hours.

Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Growth | Redwood Inference
